rules: Canonical JSON is authoritative; DOCX and PDF are generated human-readable views.
Golden Standard designation provides structural, validation and publication calibration.
Golden Standard content must not be semantically copied into unrelated capabilities or antipatterns.
During A1/AP-A1 reconstruction benchmarking, the final approved semantic A1/AP-A1 JSON must be withheld from authoring models and used only after generation for comparison.
The Golden Standard does not authorize legal conclusions, evidence adjudication, finding lock, residual-risk acceptance or lifecycle authorization.

development_approval.statement: This package is the approved and validated DEVELOPMENT_BOOTSTRAP Golden Standard calibration reference. It remains subject to final administrator verification and is not the first official complete Knowledge Base baseline.

external_dependency_policy.resolution: Resolve external dependencies through the Knowledge Base manifest and the immutable baseline snapshot.
external_dependency_policy.rule: Schemas, taxonomy, source register, tactic catalog and authoring/production contracts remain authoritative in their normal Knowledge Base locations and are not duplicated into the Golden Standard folder.

freeze_and_update_policy.rule_after_first_official_release: The first complete Knowledge Base that passes the production pipeline and explicit final human approval becomes immutable; later changes require successor versions and preserved history.
